title: A 3-Hour Trip to Practice, Then £155 Million
description:
He was offered 155 million pounds for two years. He stayed.

Sources:
- Wikipedia: Mohamed Salah: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mohamed_Salah

From Wikipedia (Mohamed Salah): born in Nagrig, Egypt, he joined the Al Mokawloon youth team at 14 and often missed school to make the three-hour journey to training; Chelsea signed him in January 2014 for a reported £11 million, and limited game time led to loans to Fiorentina and Roma; Liverpool signed him in 2017 for a club-record fee of about £36.9 million; in his first season (2017-18) he set the then-record for most Premier League goals in a 38-game season (32); in the 2023-24 preseason he received a two-year contract offer worth £155m from Saudi club Al-Ittihad, and he stayed at Liverpool. Not financial advice.

scenes.narration: He was offered 155 million pounds for two years. He stayed.
As a kid, he missed school just to get to practice. Three hours away.
Then a big club bought him. But barely played him.
Then Liverpool paid a club record. 36.9 million.
His first season? 32 goals. A record back then.
